Remember when a Vegas judge told a black attorney her #BLM pin had no connection to things happening in courtrooms. He made her take it off.

Update: That Judge (Herndon) looking to be on Nev Supreme Court. That lawyer (Ballou) running for Judge.

https://t.co/YTzMKZrMdo

Don't know the nuance, but when local authority (and force of cultural and artistic good) @FavyFav calls for a boycott of @NeonMuseum, it is necessary to amplify and call on the board for a direct response. #BLM is not a messaround in the cultural corridor. https://t.co/nSWcNPi8Xf
My latest for the Indy. Digging down into some concrete, immediate solves for #BlackLivesMatter and the protests on the streets!

For background... the case of Jemar Matthews was already overturned before on prosecutorial misconduct and racial bias by the Clark County District Attorney's office.  So this is now second time the CCDA has necessitated a retrial based on racial misconduct. #BlackLivesMatter

Its as though the NV legislators‐ many w strong ties to law enforcement- said how far can we go without offending anyone & still call it justice reform? 

Not how you get people to stop protesting in the streets. Not how you end systemic racism. #CourageOffends #BlackLivesMatter

And when the PPA is for it, you KNOW that the protests will continue. Sorry, legislature....#BlackLivesMatter and their allies are going nowhere. You don't get to placate with inoffensive measures that officers engrained in a broken system don't mind. You need to take a stand!

The Gang Unit is at the core of systemic racism that Metro denies exists. Will any public official so concerned about criminal justice reform and/or #BlackLivesMatter call them out or try to limit their boundless power? 

So proud of my law firm for being part of this legal team.

Unfun fact of the day: 

There are over 13,000 active bench warrants issued out of @CityOfLasVegas municipal court w origin dates back to 2018. 

Of that (because City's open data reports ethnicity) over 66 percent are BIPOC. Black people alone ‐‐ 47 percent. #BlackLivesMatter

...or hold police policies accountable when humans die in their custody.  

Stop justifiying the death of Black people pursued by armed police for bicycle infractions. Start reverse engineering a different policing culture. 

#BlackLivesMatter (/end)
